fusions.name: Gnawing Cloud
fusions.desc: A cloud sweeps every enemy within 3 tiles for 10 damage and leaves each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Plague Flight
fusions.desc: Sends an insect into the first enemy it meets for 5 damage, and you heal for 20% of the damage dealt. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Swarm Aloft
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Full Crop
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
